description: Both sides total 100 tokens for the day, but every category differs (subject input 20, cache write 10, cache read 40, output 30; reference 10, 20, 30, 40). Tolerance 1% is supplied only to show that within_tolerance is reported per unit.
does_not_show: That 1% is an acceptance threshold: the tolerance is a caller-supplied reporting convenience.
shows: A matching total does not hide component differences; the pair is flagged and its outcome is differs.
